data: Maska demokracije raziskuje temno plat sodobne slovenske zgodovine. Tri resnične zgodbe o obtožbah zoper Janeza Janšo, vsaka od njih je povezana z navideznimi obtožbami in spornimi praksami, so objektiv, skozi katerega lahko preučujemo sodobno slovensko zgodovino in vojno med tistimi, ki se držijo starega jugoslovanskega sistema, in tistimi, ki poskušajo vzpostaviti novega, neodvisnega, slovenskega. Zamaskirani komunisti, ki se skrivajo v senci, so spletli nenavaden labirint sodnih primerov, v katerih je uspelo Janšo obtožiti kljub pomanjkanju dokazov, navzkrižju interesov tožilstva in sodnika ter temu, da krivde ni bilo mogoče dokazati onkraj razumnega dvoma. Številni pogovori s strokovnjaki in nedavna novinarska razkritja bodo pokazali razsežnost zarote proti Janši. Ali je na videz idealna mlada država Slovenija res prešla iz enopartijskega komunističnega režima v večstrankarsko demokracijo ali pa videz vara? (Hunger, rubble, soldiers returning from war: young Charlotte is pregnant, but her beloved Ludwig doesn't want her or his child. In order to win him over and avoid the impending disgrace, she signs up for the "Fräuleinkurs" by the actress Gloria Deven who had been an aspiring star under the Nazis, but is now banned from working. But Gloria isn't interested in reviving the coquetry that had become unnecessary during the war. Instead, she awakens in her students a longing for something that has been denied them for too long: freedom.)

Hunger, rubble, soldiers returning from war: young Charlotte is pregnant, but her beloved Ludwig doesn't want her or his child. In order to win him over and avoid the impending disgrace, she signs up for the "Fräuleinkurs" by the actress Gloria Deven who had been an aspiring star under the Nazis, but is now banned from working. But Gloria isn't interested in reviving the coquetry that had become unnecessary during the war. Instead, she awakens in her students a longing for something that has been denied them for too long: freedom.
